artifacts.name: Siri-for-Windows.exe
artifacts.description: Actual unsigned self-contained native C#/WPF Windows x64 EXE, served directly by GitHub Releases. Not a ZIP, web shell, installer, downloader stub or Electron binary. .NET runtime bundled. Requires local Ollama for inference.

artifacts.name: Siri-Android-debug-apk
artifacts.description: Unchanged separate Android HTTPS web companion; optional GitHub Actions ZIP containing its debug APK. The native EXE does not host its backend.

validation: 34 companion tests and native pure-domain checks passed.
Native self-contained EXE compiled, verified with no loose DLL requirement, and actually launched on Windows CI.
GetWindowRgn verified genuinely rounded native window borders.
UI Automation found the main composer and confirmed wake starts off.
Second launch activated the existing instance; --bubble opened the actual bubble and its composer without microphone capture.
--settings opened the owned Settings dialog; UI Automation found the text and vision model selectors and closed the dialog.
After successful UI checks, Windows CI uploaded the actual EXE to GitHub Releases as a directly downloadable asset.
limitations: Real microphone recognition, accessibility fields, classic Outlook, browser history locks, model inference, screenshots and Android hardware need real-device verification. CI did not enable a microphone or send a real inference request.
Native feature parity is not complete: legacy tags, word-level writing diffs and Markdown previews are not all ported. Native and legacy stores are separate.
Native wake listens only after explicit per-session opt-in while the app runs; no closed-app background service.
GitHub sign-in/extraction and artifact retention apply. SHA-256 values identify artifact ZIP archives, not the inner EXE/APK.
settingsIntegration: Opt-in HKCU Installed Apps registration with ModifyPath opening --settings and a siriforwindows: protocol. Not an arbitrary page inside Windows Settings navigation. Integration removal leaves EXE/data intact. Actual Windows Settings frontend availability/Modify presentation requires device/version verification.
wakeBubble: Explicit per-session wake consent covers local wake phrase plus one follow-up dictation into the bubble for review. Ask sends the text; Stop/Close cancels the active bubble operation. Manual --bubble opens without enabling microphone. Actual spoken audio was not tested in CI.
localDownload: Sandbox cannot fetch binary-storage redirect hosts. The compiled EXE is hosted directly on GitHub Releases, not copied into the checkout.
